dedupe_keys.name: auckland council unitary plan historic heritage overlay layers place and extent of place

description: Auckland Council publishes two Auckland Unitary Plan overlay layers identifying historic heritage places and their extents of place as set out in the plan's Historic Heritage Overlay policy framework (chapter D17 and Schedule 14), plus related heritage overlays such as the Waitākere Ranges Heritage Area. Coverage: the Auckland region; the layers were last modified on 2026-09-25 according to the hub. Format and access: CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML downloads plus ArcGIS REST feature services, without registration from the Auckland Council open data hub. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the descriptions are one line and the scheduled item counts and attributes were not read; the overlays are planning-rule extents, not condition or structural data. Simulation uses: heritage-asset extents for exposure and retrofit-constraint layers in flood, earthquake and energy-adaptation studies of the building stock. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
